items.html: *When it arose in the will of the Emanator to emanate the world of Nekudim, His intention was to make for them the discernment of vessels, so that there would be strength in the lower worlds to receive the upper light. And the Emanator, Ein Sof, saw that the lower ones still had no strength or ability to receive these lights that come out through the Nikvey Einayim, which expand from the place of the Tabur of AK down to his feet, as will be explained. Therefore, before He emanated these lights, there was yet another, second restriction in AK, after the manner of the restriction mentioned above in Ein Sof. And it is that all the light that expanded inside the internality of this AK from the place of his Tabur downward, He raised above the place of the Tabur, into the upper half of his Guf [body], and the aforementioned place from the Tabur downward remained without lights.
